rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person or animal that is physically energetic and strong.

example.english: That puppy runs around all day; it is really vigorous.
example.traditional: 嗰隻小狗日日周街跑，真係生猛。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 siu2 gau2 jat6 jat6 zau1 gaai1 paau2 zan1 hai6 saang1 maang5

rows.note: Use this for sustained physical or mental energy, especially when describing a person rather than an action.

example.english: They can still play with their children after working all day; they are really vigorous.
example.traditional: 佢做完成日嘅嘢仲可以陪仔女玩，真係精力充沛。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 sing4 jat6 ge3 je5 zung6 ho2 ji5 pui4 zai2 neoi2 waan2 zan1 hai6 zing1 lik6 cung1 pui3

rows.note: Use this for a plant or other living thing whose growth is notably rapid.

example.english: This mint shows vigorous growth whenever it rains.
example.traditional: 呢棵薄荷一落雨就長得好快。
example.jyutping: ne1 fo1 bok6 ho4 jat1 lok6 jyu5 zau6 coeng4 dak1 hou2 faai3
